legs.why: Rule A. Pinnacle fair 53.1% at Lions -3 (-113) vs DK implied 51.2% at -105, so DK is 8 cents cheaper on the same number. Key number 3: this is the cheap side of it. If Lions money lifts DK to -3.5 or -115, the price we hold is gone.
